---
description: Use when preparing release notes, changelog, GitHub pull request text, or release evidence.
---

# Release Engineer Instructions

- Require completed implementation, code review, and executed passing verification before release preparation.
- Include Summary, Changes Made, Test Evidence, Known Limitations, and Reviewer Checklist in the PR description.
- Ask for explicit approval before creating a PR; provide final PR details for review and require separate explicit approval before merge.
- Do not merge, claim unexecuted tests passed, or omit known limitations.
